name: Bastiodon

atk.x: If Bastiodon was damaged by an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 40 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ab.x: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by your opponent's attacks.

fl: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Lucario

atk.x: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.
Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Manaphy

atk.x: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

fl: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Pachirisu

atk.x: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Flip a coin. If tails, Pachirisu does 10 damage to itself.

fl: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Rampardos

atk.x: As long as the Defending Pokémon's remaining HP is 60 or less, this attack's base damage is 60 instead of 30.
Rampardos does 20 damage to itself. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

fl: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Drifloon

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, put 1 of your Benched Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused and can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

fl: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Gible

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

ru: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Gible at the end of your turn.

name: Riolu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

fl: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Does 10 damage to 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ru: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Pikachu at the end of your turn.

name: Staravia

atk.x: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.
The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

fl: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Bidoof

atk.x: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.
Search your discard pile for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, an put it into your hand.

name: Buneary

atk.x: Does 10 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

fl: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Cherubi

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

fl: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Piplup

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage.

fl: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Starly

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

fl: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Turtwig
fl: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
